title: Notice and exclusion in class actions
shortTitle: Notice and exclusion in class actions
summary: Class notice informs absentees about the action, their rights, and the effect of participating or remaining in the class. The required method and opportunity to opt out depend on the category and procedural stage.
notes: Best practicable notice is not a guarantee that every person actually reads it. Mandatory class categories, certification notice, and settlement notice should not be collapsed into one rule.

sections.Meaning: Class notice informs absentees about the action, their rights, and the effect of participating or remaining in the class. The required method and opportunity to opt out depend on the category and procedural stage.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the class category, whether members can be identified with reasonable effort, what the notice must communicate, who pays, and when an exclusion decision must be made. Compare Eisen’s certification-notice problem with Shutts’s protection of absent damages plaintiffs.
